## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure, stooping shoulders, and kindly brown eyes. He has worn a full, soft brown beard since his twenties, paired with long hair that touches his shoulders, which has noticeably grayer and turned iron-gray over time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026)_

## Personality

A remarkably quiet, shy, and reticent man, he naturally prefers to avoid strangers and rarely volunteers information or speaks out. Despite his unobservant nature, he is exceptionally patient and wise, listening to others with good-natured, wordless enjoyment. He is known to be extremely hard-working, never scolding and routinely acting with indulgence toward those around him. Though not given to open argument, he possesses a strong inner persistence, stubbornly clinging to any opinion or whim he adopts. He harbors a deep dread of women and little girls, feeling deeply uncomfortable around them, yet he remains deeply admired for his gentle disposition and determination to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with his sister, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), having worn a full soft brown beard since he was twenty years old. He set out for [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) expecting to pick up an orphan boy to help on the farm, only to find a talkative orphan girl named [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) waiting instead. Shy by nature, Matthew brought [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and gently advocated for keeping her when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) initially wanted to send her back. He offered quiet support as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settled into [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), secretly visiting her during a punishment to persuade her to apologize to Mrs. Lynde, and surprising her with a gift of sweeties. Later, when Anne's friend's sister fell ill with severe croup while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) was away, Matthew stayed home with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and then rode off to fetch a doctor. He repeatedly encouraged Anne's creative pursuits, convincing [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let her attend a concert and sleepover, and later quietly arranging to buy [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a stylish puffed-sleeve dress for a school performance. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grew older, Matthew watched her success in her studies with deep emotional affection. Shortly after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned home after passing her Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) exams, Matthew suddenly collapsed and died after reading a notice that the Abbey Bank had failed.

## Quotes

> "I reckon she ought to be punished a little. But don’t be too hard on her, Marilla. Recollect she hasn’t ever had anyone to teach her right. You’re—you’re going to give her something to eat, aren’t you?"
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003)

> "It’ll have to be done sooner or later, you know, for Marilla’s a dreadful determined woman—dreadful determined, Anne. Do it right off, I say, and have it over."
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)

> "That’s right—that’s right, Anne. But don’t tell Marilla I said anything about it. She might think I was putting my oar in and I promised not to do that."
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019)

> “Well now, I guess you’ll manage all right,” said Matthew, looking at Anne’s white little face and the dark shadows under her eyes. “You just go right to bed and have a good sleep. I’ll do all the chores.”
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P38](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0038)

> "and—and—I dunno—but I’d like—I think they make the sleeves different nowadays to what they used to be. If it wouldn’t be asking too much I—I’d like them made in the new way."

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are the best of friends, forming a bond from the moment he brings her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Despite Marilla's initial reluctance to keep a girl, Matthew gently advocates for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stay and quietly supports her behind the scenes. He secretly visits her during punishments to offer advice and frequently surprises her with treats like sweeties.
